The '''Maintenance Droid M2-T2''' was a model of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] that was used in the Research and Development sector of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maintenance Droid M2-T2 is a type of friendly droid in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Research and Development area of the Okara Droid Factory, a Heroic area, on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
